# cursor_team_members (Data Source)

Reads Admin API team members. role is member or owner. There is no admin value. Use a lifecycle precondition, not a check block, to fail the plan when membership does not match the approved list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_team_members" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) team.
- `members` (Attributes List) Team members, including removed members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `is_removed` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `role` (String) member or owner.
